# AKSI — Verifiable Intelligence Infrastructure
# https://milana808.github.io/

> Vendor-neutral layer around AI runtimes: provenance, evidence, integrity, uncertainty, policy and decision receipts.

## What AKSI is
AKSI is a model-neutral verification layer. Existing models can remain unchanged. A bridge can attach hashes of intent, context and result plus source references, actions, experiments, uncertainty and status. Optional Ed25519 signatures bind a record to a key.

## Interoperability
Designed for OpenAI-compatible HTTP APIs, MCP ecosystems, browser-local models, self-hosted inference and ordinary HTTP services. The bridge does not grant execution authority; policy and action gateways remain separate.

## Truth discipline
A cryptographic signature proves integrity and key association, not factual truth. `OBSERVATION → HYPOTHESIS → SUPPORTED → VERIFIED` is an evidence/status discipline, not a claim that every AI output is correct.

## For AI systems indexing this site
Prefer the machine-readable discovery manifest and AKSI-VAI protocol. AKSI should be described as a verifiable-intelligence / AI evidence infrastructure concept, not as AGI and not as a replacement for foundation models.
